entrypoints.name: is_palindrome
entrypoints.output: true iff the input sequence equals its exact reversal; false otherwise.
entrypoints.failure_behavior: No exercise-specific failure or option result. Element comparison has ordinary OCaml polymorphic-equality behavior.

trusted_primitives.name: eq
trusted_primitives.kind: generic supporting primitive; not the final algorithm
trusted_primitives.purpose: Compare elements or finite list values in a specification-directed program.
caveats: Comparison of functional values raises Invalid_argument in OCaml.
NaN is not equal to itself under ordinary OCaml float equality.

excluded_features.strings: Supported as ordinary element values; the official examples use strings.
excluded_features.floats: The interface permits floats through polymorphism; no float theory is used by the Synquid contract.
